rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when liquid or loose material is accidentally poured or dropped out.

example.english: I accidentally spill my coffee when I bump the table.
example.traditional: 我撞到張枱，唔小心倒瀉咗杯咖啡。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zong6 dou2 zoeng1 toi2 m4 siu2 sam1 dou2 se3 zo2 bui1 gaa3 fe1

rows.note: Use this when someone reveals previously unknown information or a secret, especially in a sensational way.

example.english: They spill the secret online, saying that the star evaded taxes.
example.traditional: 佢喺網上爆料，話嗰個明星逃稅。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 baau3 liu2 waa6 go2 go3 ming4 sing1 tou4 seoi3

rows.note: Use this when someone pours out words or insults rapidly and at length rather than physically spilling something.

example.english: They spill embarrassing old stories nonstop whenever they get drunk.
example.traditional: 佢一飲醉就狂講以前啲臭史。
example.jyutping: keoi5 jat1 jam2 zeoi3 zau6 kwong4 gong2 ji5 cin4 di1 cau3 si2
